source_refs.note: Exercise 12.1, Question 2 (book page 230): six limits by the theorems, parts (i)-(vi). Key PDF 310: (iv) prints 0 (correct 2 sqrt 2; faint exponent read as 2), (vi) prints 13/4 (correct 13/2); rest agree. Solution book PDF 1054-1057.

blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Evaluate each limit by using theorems of limits: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 3} (2x + 4)\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain sawal kya chahta hai: ek seedhe se polynomial \(2x + 4\) ka limit jab \(x\) number \(3\) ke qareeb jaye.
Yahan koi khatra nahi: na neeche koi denominator hai jo zero ho, na koi square root jo negative ho. Is liye theorems humein seedha \(x = 3\) rakhne ki ijazat dete hain.
Plan: pehle sum aur constant multiple wale theorems se limit ko tukron mein torenge, phir \(x = 3\) rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 2x + 4\), \(x \to 3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 3} (2x + 4)\).
Tareeqa: Limits ka Theorem 1 (12.1.6): sum, difference, constant multiple, product, quotient (bas neeche ka limit zero na ho), power aur root ka limit hissa hissa kar ke nikalta hai. Polynomial ke liye is ka seedha matlab hai: \(x = a\) rakh do. Yeh isliye jaiz hai ke polynomial mein na koi denominator hai jo zero ho jaye, na koi root jo negative ho jaye.

Limit ko tukron mein torein
\[\lim_{x \to 3} (2x + 4) = 2\lim_{x \to 3} x + \lim_{x \to 3} 4\]
Kyun: Sum ka limit = limits ka sum (Theorem 1(a)). Aur constant \(2\) ko limit ke bahar nikal sakte hain (Theorem 1(c)). Sawal mein "theorems of limits" likha hai, is liye yeh tukre dikhana zaroori hai, sirf jawab likhna kaafi nahi.

Har tukre ki value nikalein
\[= 2(3) + 4\]
\[= 10\]
Kyun: \(\lim\limits_{x \to a} x = a\), yani \(x\) khud \(3\) ki taraf jata hai; aur constant ka limit wohi constant hota hai (Theorem 1(g)): \(4\) ka limit \(4\).

Tasdeeq
\[x = 2.99:\ 2(2.99) + 4 = 9.98\]
Kyun: \(x\) ko \(3\) ke bilkul qareeb rakha to jawab \(10\) ke bilkul qareeb aaya. Limit ka matlab hi yahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Evaluate each limit by using theorems of limits: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 1} (3x^2 - 2x + 4)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi ek polynomial ka limit hai, is dafa \(x \to 1\).
Polynomial mein koi khatarnaak jagah nahi hoti, is liye sum, difference, constant multiple aur power wale theorems seedha \(x = 1\) rakhne dete hain.
Plan: har term ka limit alag likhenge, phir \(x = 1\) rakh kar hisaab karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x^2 - 2x + 4\), \(x \to 1\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 1} (3x^2 - 2x + 4)\).
Tareeqa: Limits ka Theorem 1 (12.1.6): sum, difference, constant multiple, product, quotient (bas neeche ka limit zero na ho), power aur root ka limit hissa hissa kar ke nikalta hai. Polynomial ke liye is ka seedha matlab hai: \(x = a\) rakh do. Yeh isliye jaiz hai ke polynomial mein na koi denominator hai jo zero ho jaye, na koi root jo negative ho jaye.

Har term ka limit alag likhein
\[\lim_{x \to 1} (3x^2 - 2x + 4)\]
\[= 3\lim_{x \to 1} x^2 - 2\lim_{x \to 1} x + \lim_{x \to 1} 4\]
Kyun: Sum aur difference ke theorems (Theorem 1(a), (b)) se teen terms alag hue, aur constants \(3\) aur \(2\) limit ke bahar aa gaye (Theorem 1(c)).

Har tukre ki value nikalein
\[= 3(1)^2 - 2(1) + 4\]
\[= 3 - 2 + 4 = 5\]
Kyun: Power wala theorem kehta hai \(\lim\limits_{x \to a} x^p = a^p\), is liye \(x^2 \to 1^2 = 1\). Constant \(4\) ka limit \(4\) hi rehta hai.
Dhyan dein: Pehle power, phir multiply: \(3(1)^2 = 3\), na ke \((3 \times 1)^2\).

Tasdeeq
\[x = 1.01:\ 3(1.0201) - 2.02 + 4\]
\[= 5.0403\]
Kyun: \(x\) ko \(1\) ke qareeb rakha to jawab \(5\) ke qareeb aaya, is liye hamara limit sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Evaluate each limit by using theorems of limits: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 3} \sqrt{x^2 + x + 4}\).
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa polynomial square root ke andar hai, aur \(x \to 3\).
Square root tab tak theek hai jab tak andar wala number negative na ho. Is liye pehle andar check karenge.
Plan: andar ki value check, phir limit ko root ke andar le jayenge, phir \(x = 3\) rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 + x + 4}\), \(x \to 3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 3} \sqrt{x^2 + x + 4}\).
Tareeqa: Root wala theorem (Theorem 1(g), power \(p = 1/2\)): \(\lim \sqrt{f(x)} = \sqrt{\lim f(x)}\), jab andar ka limit positive ho. Square root asal mein power \(1/2\) hi hai, is liye power wala theorem yahan bhi lagta hai.

\(x = 3\) par andar ki value check karein
\[3^2 + 3 + 4 = 16 > 0\]
Kyun: Real numbers mein negative ka square root nahi hota. Andar \(16\) aaya jo positive hai, is liye \(x = 3\) ke aas paas root bilkul theek defined hai.

Limit ko root ke andar le jayein
\[\lim_{x \to 3} \sqrt{x^2 + x + 4} = \sqrt{\lim_{x \to 3} (x^2 + x + 4)}\]
Kyun: Root ka limit = limit ka root (Theorem 1(g)). Is se mushkil sawal aasaan ho gaya: ab sirf andar wale polynomial ka limit chahiye.

Value rakh kar simplify karein
\[= \sqrt{9 + 3 + 4}\]
\[= \sqrt{16} = 4\]
Kyun: Andar polynomial hai, is liye \(x = 3\) seedha rakh diya. \(\sqrt{16}\) ka matlab hamesha positive root \(4\) hota hai, \(\pm 4\) nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{x^2 + x + 4}\) ko \(x + \sqrt{x} + 2\) jaisa tod dena bohat bari ghalti hai; sum ka square root alag alag nahi tootta.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 3.01:\ \sqrt{16.0701} \approx 4.009\]
Kyun: \(3\) ke qareeb \(x\) par jawab \(4\) ke qareeb hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Evaluate each limit by using theorems of limits: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 2} \sqrt{x^2 + 4}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi square root ka limit hai, \(x \to 2\); tareeqa bilkul part (iii) wala.
Andar \(x^2 + 4\) hai jo hamesha positive hai (kam az kam \(4\)), is liye root kabhi masla nahi karega.
Plan: limit ko root ke andar le jayenge, \(x = 2\) rakhenge, phir surd (root wala jawab) ko simplify karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 + 4}\), \(x \to 2\). (Kitab mein power halki chhapi hai; ghaur se dekhein to yeh \(2\) hai, bilkul part (iii) jaisi.)
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 2} \sqrt{x^2 + 4}\).
Tareeqa: Root wala theorem (Theorem 1(g)): \(\lim \sqrt{f(x)} = \sqrt{\lim f(x)}\).

\(x = 2\) par andar check karein
\[2^2 + 4 = 8 > 0\]
Kyun: Root ke andar positive number hai, is liye root defined hai aur value rakhna jaiz hai.

Limit andar le ja kar value rakhein
\[\lim_{x \to 2} \sqrt{x^2 + 4} = \sqrt{\lim_{x \to 2} (x^2 + 4)}\]
\[= \sqrt{4 + 4} = \sqrt{8}\]
Kyun: Root ka limit = limit ka root. Andar polynomial hai, is liye \(x = 2\) seedha rakh diya.

Surd ko simplify karein
\[\sqrt{8} = \sqrt{4 \times 2}\]
\[= 2\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: \(8\) ke andar perfect square \(4\) chhupa hai. \(\sqrt{4} = 2\) bahar aa gaya aur \(\sqrt{2}\) andar reh gaya. Jawab ko hamesha simplest surd form mein likhein.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 2.01:\ \sqrt{8.0401} \approx 2.8355\]
\[2\sqrt{2} \approx 2.8284\]
Kyun: Dono qareeb qareeb barabar hain, is liye limit \(2\sqrt{2}\) hai. Socho: jo number kam az kam \(4\) ho, us ka root kabhi \(0\) nahi ho sakta. Is liye answer key ka \(0\) ghalat hai (neeche dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein part (iv) ka jawab \(0\) chhapa hai, jo chhape hue sawal ke liye ghalat hai: \(x \to 2\) par \(\sqrt{x^2 + 4} \to \sqrt{8} = 2\sqrt{2}\). Key ka \(0\) tab sahi hota jab sawal \(\sqrt{x^2 - 4}\) hota. Sahi jawab \(2\sqrt{2}\) hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (v) Evaluate each limit by using theorems of limits: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 2} \left(\sqrt{x^3 + 1} - \sqrt{x^2 + 5}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan do square roots ka farq (difference) hai, aur \(x \to 2\).
\(x = 2\) par dono roots ke andar positive number aata hai, is liye har root ka limit seedha value rakh kar mil jayega.
Plan: pehle difference wala theorem, phir har hisse par root wala theorem.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^3 + 1} - \sqrt{x^2 + 5}\), \(x \to 2\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 2} f(x)\).
Tareeqa: Difference ka theorem (Theorem 1(b)) aur root ka theorem (Theorem 1(g)).

\(x = 2\) par dono roots ka andar check karein
\[2^3 + 1 = 9 > 0\]
\[2^2 + 5 = 9 > 0\]
Kyun: Dono jagah positive number hai, is liye dono roots defined hain aur theorem lagana jaiz hai.

Limit ko do hisson mein torein
\[\lim_{x \to 2} f(x) = \sqrt{\lim_{x \to 2}(x^3 + 1)} - \sqrt{\lim_{x \to 2}(x^2 + 5)}\]
Kyun: Difference ka limit = limits ka difference. Phir har root ka limit = andar wale limit ka root.

Value rakh kar simplify karein
\[= \sqrt{9} - \sqrt{9}\]
\[= 3 - 3 = 0\]
Kyun: Dono andar polynomials hain, \(x = 2\) rakh diya. Yeh \(0\) asli, mukammal jawab hai, kyunke yeh \(3 - 3\) se aaya hai. Yeh \(0/0\) jaisi undecided shakal nahi, is liye aage kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{x^3 + 1} - \sqrt{x^2 + 5}\) ko \(\sqrt{x^3 + 1 - x^2 - 5}\) likhna ghalat hai; roots ka farq ek root nahi banta.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 2.01:\ \sqrt{9.1206} - \sqrt{9.0401}\]
\[\approx 3.0200 - 3.0067 = 0.0133\]
Kyun: \(x\) ko \(2\) ke qareeb rakha to farq zero ke qareeb aaya.

blocks.prompt: 2 (vi) Evaluate each limit by using theorems of limits: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 2} \frac{2x^3 + 5x}{3x - 2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan do polynomials ka quotient (taqseem) hai, \(x \to 2\).
Quotient wala theorem tabhi lagta hai jab neeche wala hissa zero ki taraf na jaye. Is liye sab se pehle denominator check karenge.
Plan: neeche check, phir upar aur neeche ke limits alag alag, phir divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \dfrac{2x^3 + 5x}{3x - 2}\), \(x \to 2\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim\limits_{x \to 2} f(x)\).
Tareeqa: Quotient ka theorem (Theorem 1(f)): \(\lim \dfrac{f}{g} = \dfrac{\lim f}{\lim g}\), shart yeh ke \(\lim g \ne 0\).

\(x = 2\) par neeche check karein
\[3(2) - 2 = 4 \ne 0\]
Kyun: Zero se divide karna mumkin nahi. Neeche \(4\) aaya, is liye theorem bekhauf lag sakta hai.

Upar ka limit
\[\lim_{x \to 2} (2x^3 + 5x) = 2(2)^3 + 5(2)\]
\[= 16 + 10 = 26\]
Kyun: Upar polynomial hai, \(x = 2\) rakh diya. Pehle power: \(2^3 = 8\), phir \(2 \times 8 = 16\).
Dhyan dein: \(2(2)^3\) ko \(4^3 = 64\) samajhna aam ghalti hai; power sirf \(2\) par hai, coefficient par nahi.

Divide karein
\[\lim_{x \to 2} f(x) = \frac{26}{4}\]
\[= \frac{13}{2}\]
Kyun: Quotient theorem se upar ka limit neeche ke limit par divide hua. Phir \(26\) aur \(4\) dono ko \(2\) se kaata to \(13/2\) mila.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 2.01:\ \frac{2(8.1206) + 10.05}{4.03}\]
\[= \frac{26.2912}{4.03} \approx 6.524\]
Kyun: Yeh \(13/2 = 6.5\) ke qareeb hai, \(13/4 = 3.25\) ke nahi. Is se saaf hai ke answer key ka \(13/4\) ghalat hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein part (vi) ka jawab \(\frac{13}{4}\) chhapa hai, jo ghalat hai: upar \(26\) ki taraf aur neeche \(4\) ki taraf jata hai, is liye limit \(\frac{26}{4} = \frac{13}{2}\) hai. Sahi jawab \(\frac{13}{2}\) hai.
